description.description: Explanation of what the measurement represents.

formattedValue.description: Display-ready value including applicable formatting, units, or currency. Use this value when presenting the metric to users.

numericValue.description: Raw numeric value. Use this value for calculations instead of parsing the formatted value.

previousFormattedValue.description: Display-ready value for the comparison period, or null when comparison data is unavailable.

previousNumericValue.description: Raw numeric value for the comparison period, or null when comparison data is unavailable.

change.description: Signed arithmetic difference calculated as the requested-period value minus the comparison-period value, or null when comparison data is unavailable.

relativeChangePercent.description: Signed relative percentage change from the comparison-period value, or null when it cannot be calculated.

description: One named measurement for the requested period with an optional comparison-period value.
